(1)  Every  service  provider  from  whom  any

column1: information  or  data  has  been  requested  or  obtained  under
this Act or  any person to whom a written notice has been
issued for the preservation of any information or  data under
section 27 shall maintain strict confidentiality in relation to
such information or data and the fact that such information
or  data  has  been  requested,  obtained  or  required  to  be
preserved,  and  shall  not  make  any  disclosure  in  regard  to
such matters other than with lawful authority.

column2: A  service  provider  shall  not  be  held  liable  under

column1: the civil or criminal law for the disclosure of any information
or data for the purposes of an investigation under this Act.

column2: (1) The secretary of the Board of Management of

column1: every National Association of Sports recognized under this
Act shall maintain a code of ethics, subject to the directions
of the Secretary, governing the conduct of   persons connected
to such sport for the purpose of ensuring the maintenance of
discipline and prevention of match fixing, corruption, illegal
manipulation and illegal betting in such sport.

column2: Every person connected to a sport shall be bound

column1: by  the  provisions  of  the  code  of  ethics  of  the  respective
sport.

column2: (3)    Any  person  connected  to  a  sport  who  acts  in

column1: contravention of the provisions of the code of ethics of such
sport shall also be liable to such sanctions as may be provided
for in such code of ethics.
